name: tool-jasonparser-realcryptocap-market-brief-srwkkp4n
description: Real crypto market prices, 24h change, and AI-composed market briefs. Real market cap methodology excludes stablecoins, wrapped/staked receipts, and tokenized assets. Full RealCryptoCap API/CLI/MCP is Pro/Ultra only.
author: Node0 Data Systems / RealCryptoCap <contact@realcryptocap.com>

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get current USD price, market cap, and rank for one or more native cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins, wrapped/staked receipts and tokenized assets are excluded by the RealCryptoCap filter. Pass CoinGecko ids such as bitcoin, ethereum, solana.

parameters.name: coin_ids
parameters.description: Comma separated CoinGecko ids, e.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum'. Default 'bitcoin'.

tools.name: get_24h_change
tools.description: Get 24 hour price change percent, 24h high/low, and 24h volume for one or more native cryptocurrencies.

parameters.name: coin_ids
parameters.description: Comma separated CoinGecko ids, e.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum'. Default 'bitcoin'.

tools.name: get_ai_summary
tools.description: Compose an AI market brief from live RealCryptoCap data. Fetches prices, 24h change and 24h range plus headline news (with links), then asks the Anna host LLM to write a short brief: bias, key levels (24h low/high, stated basis) and what to watch. Returns the brief, a data timestamp and source notes.

parameters.name: coin_ids
parameters.description: Comma separated CoinGecko ids to focus on. Default 'bitcoin,ethereum'.
